stakeholders.name: The Ministry of Mines and Steels Development (MMSD)
stakeholders.description:
Formulate and implement national policies for solid minerals development, regulate and supervise the mining sector,
 and drive investment and value addition.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Policy leadership, regulation and strategic coordination across the mineral value chain.

stakeholders.name: Mining Cadastre Office (MCO)
stakeholders.description: Administer and manage mineral titles in Nigeria through a transparent mining cadastre system.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Administration of mineral rights, licensing and tenure management.

stakeholders.name: Mines Inspectorate
stakeholders.description: Enforce mine health, safety and technical standards and monitor compliance with mining regulations.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Operational oversight, safety enforcement and production monitoring.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: All licensed mine sites in Nigeria

stakeholders.name: Nigerian Geological Survey Agency (NGSA)
stakeholders.description: Generate, store and disseminate geoscientific and mineral resource data for Nigeria.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Upstream geological mapping, resource identification and exploration support.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Entire national territory and offshore areas under Nigerian control

stakeholders.name: National Environmental Standards and Regulations Enforcement Agency (NESREA)
stakeholders.description: Enforce environmental laws, regulations and standards (excluding upstream oil and gas) across Nigeria.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Environmental compliance, pollution control and enforcement in mining and processing.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Federal Republic of Nigeria (excluding upstream petroleum operations)

stakeholders.name: Raw Materials Research and Development Council (RMRDC)
stakeholders.description: Promote research, development and utilisation of Nigeria’s raw materials for industrialisation.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Linking minerals to industry, processing and manufacturing value chains.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Nationwide raw materials and industrial sectors

stakeholders.name: Nigeria Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (NEITI)
stakeholders.description: Promote transparency and accountability in the management of revenues from Nigeria’s extractive industries.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Revenue transparency, governance and accountability across the value chain.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: All extractive sectors and government entities handling extractive revenues in Nigeria

stakeholders.name: The Department of Mines Environmental Compliance (MEC)
stakeholders.description: Oversee and coordinate environmental compliance obligations specific to mining operations under MMSD.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Sector‑specific environmental oversight within the mining value chain.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Mining and quarrying operations across Nigeria

stakeholders.name: Artisanal & Small-Scale Mining
stakeholders.description: Formalise, support and regulate artisanal and small‑scale mining activities in Nigeria.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: ASM formalisation, support services and integration into the formal minerals economy.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Artisanal and small‑scale mining operators nationwide

stakeholders.name: Solid Minerals Development Fund (SMDF)
stakeholders.description: Provide financing and catalytic investments to stimulate exploration and development of Nigeria’s solid minerals.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Project finance, de‑risking exploration and supporting early‑stage development.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Eligible solid minerals projects across Nigeria

stakeholders.name: National Assembly Committee on Mines & Steel
stakeholders.description: Exercise legislative oversight over the mines and steel sector and review relevant laws and budgets.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Legislative oversight, law‑making and budget scrutiny for the minerals sector.
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Federal legislative oversight across all mining institutions and programmes

stakeholders.name: National Steel Raw Materials Exploration Agency (NSRMEA )
stakeholders.description: Explore and evaluate raw materials required for the iron and steel industry in Nigeria.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Upstream exploration for steel‑related minerals (iron ore, coal, limestone, etc.).
stakeholders.jurisdiction: Prospective iron and steel raw material provinces across Nigeria
